articles.summary: Teradata, the cloud data and analytics company, today announced the appointment of Christian Schwarz as new Country Manager for Austria and Central & Eastern Europe (CEE). With Christian Schwarz, another Country Manager with many years of sales experience in the IT industry joins Teradata.
articles.title: Teradata Appoints Christian Schwarz as Country Manager Austria and Central & Eastern Europe

articles.summary: Teradata, today announced a myriad of enhancements to its as-a-service offerings for Teradata Vantage on public cloud providers AWS and Microsoft Azure.
articles.title: Teradata Strengthens Cloud Offerings on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure

articles.summary: Teradata offers Disaster Recovery as a Service, providing on-premises customers a public cloud environment on-demand so that business operations can carry on with minimal disruption.
articles.title: Teradata Expands Options for Disaster Recovery in the Cloud
